notes: The complete named schema surface is represented over the primitive Coq modal syntax.

The recursive translation, nat-atom generic proof translation, semantic idempotence, binary/list conjunction, cumulative iterated-box law, reflexive-closure truth/validity, and reflexivize-after-irreflexivize equivalences are checked; the atom-polymorphic proof theorem and separate Lean big-conjunction/Finset wrappers remain represented only by nat/list counterparts.
The complete pinned theorem surface is checked unconditionally: S4-to-translated-K4, the internal S4 formula equivalence, translated-K4-to-S4, and the final iff for the named nat-atom logics.

Both finite GL/Grz frame transformations are checked unconditionally. The forward, reverse, and iff proof-theoretic results explicitly require boxdot_GL_finite_complete and/or boxdot_Grz_finite_complete; no completeness inhabitant is claimed.

The finite GL.3/Grz.3 frame transformations and named-system soundness are checked. Both translated proof directions and their two iff aliases explicitly require the corresponding GLPoint3/GrzPoint3 finite-completeness propositions.
The Triv-to-translated-Ver theorem is unconditional, including translated T and Tc; Ver-to-Triv and both iff aliases explicitly require boxdot_Triv_complete.

Doubled frames, five inherited relation properties, the surjective p-morphism, six frame-class closure results, flags, boxdot logic properties, and BDP_of_SBDP are checked. The main and six named BDP surfaces retain explicit logic-completeness and jerabek_global_consequence_bridge hypotheses because the finite global-consequence/fresh-atom API is not yet ported.

Every mathematical theorem shape is checked for the normal-schema calculus over nat atoms: finite consistency and insertion/singleton/union laws, deterministic enumeration and complementary closure, finite-context Lindenbaum extension, derivability/complement/implication membership laws, and an explicit powerset cover. The status remains partial because Foundation is polymorphic over arbitrary decidable atom types and abstract classical entailments, whereas Coq uses nat atoms and extensional list/predicate contexts.
Primitive syntax, derived connectives, substitution, complexity, degree, subformula closure, and a surjective enumeration over nat atoms are checked; upstream generic convenience APIs remain.

The atom-polymorphic syntactic complement, complement-closed finite contexts, and semantic incompatibility are checked, together with all three proof-theoretic complement lemmas for the normal-schema nat-atom calculus. The abstract atom-polymorphic entailment versions remain represented only by that specialization.

NNF syntax, decidable equality, structural negation, translations, degree, modal CNF/DNF predicates, and a surjective enumeration over nat atoms are checked; Lean-specific generic encoding instances remain.
The concrete modal connectives and boxdot operation are represented; upstream abstract connective typeclasses remain.

The complete mathematical surface is checked: decidable modal words, composition, polarity, exact and bounded size splitting, formula action/substitution, translation/equivalence algebra and expansion, standard-axiom reductions, finite size layers, and generic reduction bootstrapping. Lean notation, ToString/Repr, typeclass plumbing, and Finset coercions are representation-only; Coq uses duplicate-insensitive lists.

All four length-two laws, the length-zero through length-three reductions, and the all-length theorem are subsumed by a checked recursive normalizer proving every modality S5-equivalent to one of the six canonical forms.
Polymorphic additional-axiom schemata, inclusion, substitution closure, and sound interpretation are checked; upstream finite axiom-set encodings and notation remain.
Formula-indexed frames/models, full satisfaction algebra, validity and countermodel equivalences, sound structural rules, and failure of replacement of equivalents are checked.
Soundness for arbitrary instantiated axiom predicates and PLoN frame classes, the soundness interface, and consistency from a nonempty class are checked.
An explicit Lindenbaum/MCS construction, formula-indexed canonical frame/model, truth lemma, countermodels, and completeness from canonical-class membership are checked.
The import-only umbrella is represented by the integrated PLoN N development.
All-frame N soundness, consistency, canonical completeness, sound-completeness, and the strict inclusions N below EN and K are checked with explicit two-world countermodels.

Formula-enumerated Lindenbaum chains, finite-stage localization, consistency preservation, and maximal completion are checked for K and arbitrary normal axiom schemata in a one-sided presentation; the upstream two-sided convenience API remains.

Maximal consistent theories for K and arbitrary normal schemata, Lindenbaum extension, derivability closure, negation/implication membership, and the modal successor lemma are checked. Finite nat-context insertion, singleton, union, and bounded complement-complete membership laws are now also checked; upstream list-connective and atom-polymorphic convenience lemmas remain.

The concrete K metatheory and a substitution-closed calculus parameterized by arbitrary modal axiom schemata are checked, including its nat-list finite consistency/insertion and complement-closed context layer. Upstream atom-polymorphic finite-context and derived-rule conveniences remain.
Normal K, necessitation, regularity, modal distribution, substitution, and its embedding into every normal extension are checked; the full upstream derived-connective library remains.
The T schema, substitution closure, K inclusion, reflexive-frame soundness/completeness, consistency, and strictness over K are checked; upstream derived T and diamond rules remain.
The D schema, substitution closure, serial-frame soundness, and consistency are checked; upstream derived seriality rules remain.
The B schema, substitution closure, symmetric-frame soundness, and consistency are checked; upstream derived symmetry laws remain.

The Four schema, substitution closure, K inclusion, transitive-frame soundness/completeness, consistency, strictness over K, and nat-atom translated-boxdot direction are checked; other upstream iterated-box derivations and atom-polymorphic conveniences remain.
The Five schema, substitution closure, right-Euclidean soundness, and consistency are checked; upstream derived Euclidean laws remain.

The combined T/Four calculus, KT/K4 inclusions and strictness, preorder soundness/completeness, consistency, and the unconditional nat-atom p iff boxdot-translation theorem are checked; remaining upstream derived rules and atom-polymorphic conveniences remain.

The combined T/Five calculus, KT/K5 inclusions, soundness, consistency, diamond-box/box and all six canonical modality equivalences are checked; the remaining upstream named derived-rule convenience surface remains.
The Loeb-schema normal calculus, substitution closure, GL-frame soundness, and consistency are checked; upstream internalized provability derivations remain.
The Grz-schema normal calculus, substitution closure, relational soundness, and consistency are checked; upstream derived Grz rules remain.
The general semantic correspondence and named instances are checked; canonical-frame instances await the Hilbert layer.
Weak n-transitivity, its exact Geach characterization, arbitrary-formula validity, and the atomic converse are checked; the generic canonical-frame instance awaits named Hilbert systems.

The exact Grz correspondence with reflexivity, transitivity, and weak converse well-foundedness is checked, including the irreflexive-reduction characterization; finite-frame convenience instances remain.
Detour-freedom and no-proper-detour are characterized, imply antisymmetry, and exactly correspond to atomic H validity; generated-frame and canonical instances remain.
The Boolos frame condition and its transitive-frame validity theorem are checked for arbitrary formulas.
The exact atomic frame correspondence is checked; finite-frame convenience instances remain.
The McKinsey frame condition and arbitrary-formula validity theorem are checked; the extended-Hilbert derivations and canonical instance remain.
The Makinson frame condition and arbitrary-formula Mk validity theorem are checked; the canonical theorem, which contains an upstream sorry at the pin, remains.
The exact semantic correspondence is checked; canonical-frame connectedness awaits the Hilbert layer.
The Sobocinski condition, its structural consequences, arbitrary-formula validity, and exact atomic converse are checked; the canonical-frame instance remains.
Isolation is shown exactly equivalent to atomic Ver validity; the named-system canonical instance remains.
Piecewise convergence is shown exactly equivalent to atomic WeakPoint2 validity, with arbitrary-formula and strong-to-weak corollaries; the named-system canonical instance remains.
Piecewise connectedness, its distinct-successor characterization, and its exact atomic WeakPoint3 correspondence are checked; the named-system canonical instance remains.

The complete mathematical surface is checked atom-polymorphically: predicate-set complex algebras, box/top and box/intersection laws, diamond duality, formula evaluation equals Kripke satisfaction, and validity of implication/equivalence/formulas is exactly subset/extensional equality/top. Extensional equivalence replaces Lean set equality and avoids extensionality axioms.
Antisymmetry, strict/pre/partial orders, and closure preservation are checked; Lean-only inherited instances are unnecessary in the Coq representation.
Asymmetry is characterized by irreflexivity plus antisymmetry, including the transitive specialization.

The pinned class assumptions are proved inconsistent and its admitted unrestricted farthest-point lemma is refuted by natLT; a coherent preorder balloon and the intended maximal-counterexample/Z results are checked with converse well-foundedness explicit.
Core frames, models, validity, iteration, substitution, and K validity are checked; upstream generated-model and frame-class utilities remain.
Reflexive, positive, and reflexive-transitive closures and their exact algebraic and frame-property preservation theorems are checked.
Clusters are represented extensionally with quotient-equivalent membership/equality laws, finite skeleton covers, order structures, and the full degenerate/simple/proper classification.
The bounded generated frame/model, budgeted subformula truth lemma, root truth theorem, and target-invariance theorem are checked generically over atom types.

Canonical frames/models, modal successor existence, truth lemmas, countermodels, and a generic canonical-class completeness theorem are checked for arbitrary normal schemata; upstream two-sided and iterated relation characterizations remain.

The complete pinned theorem surface is checked: finite root extension, root/tree laws, ordered chains and exact covers, embedding p-morphism and truth, boxdot root transfer, and T-failure cardinality/witness results; explicit conjunction, list-cover, and cardinality predicates replace Lean wrappers.
Coarsest, finest, and transitive-closure filtrations, truth lemmas, finite bounds, and elementary preservation are checked; rooted confluence/connectedness preservation remains.

K theoremhood/contextual derivability and arbitrary substitution-closed normal axiom extensions are framewise sound, with a generic inhabited-frame consistency theorem; frame-class wrapper instances remain.
Irreflexivity and its closure/order relationships are checked constructively.
All pinned construction, finiteness, and frame-property inheritance theorems are checked; the same-carrier coercion is definitional, and reflexivized truth/validity equivalences are also proved.

Natural strict/nonstrict and bounded linear frames, their structural properties and roots, duplicate-free finite covers for bounded carriers, and the full natLT-Z and natLE-Dum validity theorems are checked.
Soundness, consistency, canonical completeness, and finite-frame completeness of concrete Hilbert K are independently checked.
K4 canonicality, soundness/completeness on transitive frames, consistency, and strictness over K are checked; finite completeness remains.
KT canonicality, soundness/completeness on reflexive frames, consistency, and strictness over K are checked; the source's stronger KD-to-KT strictness witness remains.
KD is sound on serial frames and consistent; canonical completeness and strictness remain.
KB is sound on symmetric frames and consistent; canonical completeness and strictness remain.
K5 is sound on right-Euclidean frames and consistent; canonical completeness and strictness remain.
S4 canonicality, preorder soundness/completeness, consistency, and strictness over KT and K4 are checked; finite completeness and the KD4 strictness chain remain.

The S5 canonical frame is proved reflexive and right-Euclidean, yielding checked soundness/completeness and consistency on that frame class; the source's point-generated universal-frame equivalence and strict-inclusion chain remain.
The Loeb-schema calculus is sound on every transitive converse-well-founded frame and consistent via an explicit finite irreflexive singleton witness.
The Grz calculus is sound on reflexive transitive weakly converse-well-founded frames and consistent; finite partial-order-to-McKinsey convenience instances remain.
Direct NNF semantics, classical negation, both syntax translations, model/frame validity equivalences, and semantic round trips are checked generically over atom types.
Bisimulation invariance and bounded-morphism truth/validity preservation are checked; closure and injectivity utilities remain.

All path/rank, rooted-height, modal box-bottom, point-generated restriction, and one-root successor laws are proved from an exact rank specification; finite cwf rank construction and the general multi-root API remain, while the pinned point-generated axiom is replaced by a proof.
Roots, generated frames/models, inherited relation properties and explicit finite covers, bounded morphisms, truth invariance, and positive-reachability generation are checked.
Target termination, direct termination on transitive frames, closure invariance, converse-well-founded consequences, and target terminality are checked.

Immediate and transitive snoc-path unravellings, rootedness, exact length growth, tree order, endpoint p-morphisms, and truth preservation are checked; list-normal-form and finite typeclass convenience instances remain representation-specific.
The two-cycle-to-singleton bounded-morphism proof of irreflexivity undefinability is checked constructively.
A deep translation for the full primitive modal syntax and arbitrary atom types strengthens the upstream NNFormula/nat statement.
